title: v1.2 replacement for format-11: accounts.yaml includes provider selection

{home}/.kogen/accounts.yaml.text:
# Kogen accounts on this machine, written by kogen provider use.
chatgpt:
  projects:
    - path: "{checkout}"
      account: default
selection:
  projects:
    - path: "{checkout}"
      provider: chatgpt

notes: provider use writes the ChatGPT account map and the project provider selection map atomically; the expected bytes follow §2.7 and provider resolution follows §4.10.
